konflikt.fehler: Someone else has changed this folder in the meantime – including {felder}. Decide for each field what should apply and save again.
konflikt.standUngueltig: “stand” must be a point in time – ideally the folder’s “geaendert” value as you read it.
konflikt.titel: Changed at the same time – what should apply?
konflikt.einleitung: While you were editing here, this folder was also changed elsewhere. All other changes – yours and the others’ – are merged. Only here did both change the same field:
konflikt.anderer: {name} changed “{feld}” {wann} to {aktuell}. You wanted to enter {deins}.
konflikt.selbst: You changed “{feld}” {wann} on another device or in another window to {aktuell}. Here you wanted to enter {deins}.
konflikt.andererGeheim: {name} changed the password “{feld}” {wann}. You entered a different one here.
konflikt.selbstGeheim: You changed the password “{feld}” {wann} on another device or in another window. You entered a different one here.
konflikt.fehlt: Choose for each field what should apply.
konflikt.status: Not saved yet – decide above what should apply.
mitnehmen.grund: You lack the “Export” permission (E) for this folder. It applies to everything that lets files leave Ablago: downloading, sharing, sending, exporting and the drive.
mitnehmen.ansehen: You can view the documents here in Ablago. The person who administers Ablago grants the permission on the views.
aufgabe.ohne-leserecht: Task for a folder you may not see – ask {name}
aufgabe.ohne-leserecht.admin: Task for a folder you may not see – ask the person who administers Ablago
aufgabe.zuweisen.text: The task reaches {name}, but the folder doesn’t. The person who administers Ablago is informed.
leserecht.vergeben: Read access granted to {name} because of the task “{aufgabe}” (by {von})
leserecht.entzogen.erledigt: Read access of {name} withdrawn again after the task was completed
leserecht.entzogen.geloescht: Read access of {name} withdrawn again after the task was deleted
leserecht.entzogen.weitergegeben: Read access of {name} withdrawn again after the task was handed over
leserecht.entzogen.lesbar: Temporary read access of {name} ended – the permissions now allow reading anyway
entsperren.hinweis: This PDF is protected with a password. Enter the password so Ablago can display and search it.
entsperren.merken.hilfe: Ablago stores the password encrypted in your account and tries it for you on new post.
entsperren.name: Name for the password
entsperren.fertig: Unlocked. Preview and full text follow shortly.
entsperren.fertig-gemerkt: Unlocked and remembered. Preview and full text follow shortly.
entsperren.entsperrt: Ablago shows the unlocked version. The original stays unchanged.
entsperren.entsperrt-gemerkt: Unlocked with the remembered password “{name}”. The original stays unchanged.
entsperren.rechte: Printing or copying is locked in the PDF. For preview and full text Ablago treats it like a normal PDF; the original stays unchanged.
entsperren.ohne-qpdf: qpdf is not installed – protected PDFs therefore can’t be unlocked.
entsperren.kaputt: The PDF couldn’t be unlocked. It is probably damaged.
entsperren.passwort-lang: The password is too long (at most {max} characters).
entsperren.passwort-zeile: The password must not contain a line break.
entsperren.name-fehlt: Please enter a name for the password.
entsperren.zu-viele: Too many wrong attempts. Please wait {minuten} minutes and then try again.
entsperren.falsch_one: The password is wrong. {anzahl} attempt left.
entsperren.falsch_other: The password is wrong. {anzahl} attempts left.
entsperren.aus: Protected PDFs can’t be unlocked here.
entsperren.gemerkt.aus: Passwords for documents are not set up here.
entsperren.gemerkt.ohne-schluessel: Passwords can only be remembered once a key has been created in the Workbench under “Encryption”.
entsperren.gemerkt.voll: You have already remembered {max} passwords for documents. First delete one under “My account → Security”.
entsperren.gemerkt.unlesbar: This password is encrypted with a different key and can’t be read. Please delete it and remember it again.
entsperren.gemerkt.nur-browser: Passwords for documents only exist in your own sign-in in the browser or the app, not with an API key.
entsperren.gemerkt.vertretung: Passwords for documents belong only to this person – not visible even when standing in.
entsperren.gemerkt.bestaetigen: Please confirm first with your password or a two-factor sign-in code.
pdf.unstimmig: The PDF has inconsistent cross-references and isn’t read, to protect the server.
verwaltungsmodus.hinweis: You only see this folder in administration mode. This is noted in its history.
systemrolle.hinweis: Every person has the system role “Member”.
